title: Licenses: new major notice and duration states
summary: DJDL's Licenses list the day 5.0.0-beta.1 is published: the new-major notice above the list (Start a 5.x tier…, Extend Pro 4 to 5.x…, Dismiss), the Renewing, Past due and Updates ended facets, and a Duration column that shows every subscription state (trialing, active, past due, canceled, expired) beside trials, version-scoped and lifetime licenses, with each subscription's source.
compare: The notice is an info callout above the toolbar that names the build, the tier whose line it leaves and the license count. Its actions are Start a 5.x tier… and Extend Pro 4 to 5.x… (outline buttons) and Dismiss (ghost); New license in the header stays the page's only primary. It shows once per tier and major and comes back in Pro 4's record until dismissed. Extend Pro 4 to 5.x… opens entitlements.extend-major.
It appears on the first build of a new major on any release track (here a beta), since beta testers on Pro 4 are already refused it.
The toolbar keeps search (names, emails, keys) and the Tier and Holder facets and adds Renewing, Past due and Updates ended with their counts.

The Duration column says the state first in plain words: 'Trialing until Oct 24, then yearly', 'Renews Oct 3, 2027', 'Grace until Oct 14' (past due: the pill says so, the text doesn't repeat it), 'Canceled · runs until Nov 3', 'Updates ended at 4.1.3 · keeps working' (expired with keeps the last version), 'Trial ends Oct 21, then Standard', '4.x · no end date', 'Lifetime'. The second line names the source (Manual, External billing) and the period.
A trial tier (Pro trial) and a subscription that is trialing (Jonah, External billing) read differently, so the two meanings of trial never share a label.
Only past due and an unverified email get pills, at the right edge; active, canceled and expired-but-working rows have none.
Phone: Tier, Duration and Devices fold into one line under the holder, with the unit ('7 of 10 devices'); the notice's three buttons wrap under its text; the facets wrap.
The subtitle lists the tiers in list order, best first: 'Pro, Pro trial, Pro 4 and Standard'. Every holder line ends with how the license is held (In an account, Waiting, or Floating).
The table foot shows '1–50 of 240' with previous and next page buttons (previous disabled on the first page).

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fix, then pass: New license is the only primary, the notice's actions are outline, the list reads in list order with units, and the Extend dialog is drawn.

findings.issue: Two filled primary buttons a few pixels apart: New license in the header and Start a 5.x tier… in the notice; on phone they stack.
findings.resolution: New license stays the page's only primary. The notice's actions are outline buttons (Start a 5.x tier…, Extend Pro 4 to 5.x…) plus a ghost Dismiss, here, in Pro 4's record and behind the two dialogs. The rule is recorded in kit/README.md under Callouts: a callout's actions are outline or ghost, never primary.

findings.issue: Past due shown twice in one row; Northside lacks 'In an account'; the subtitle's tier order doesn't match the records; phone '7 of 10' has no unit; '1–50' has no paging; the Extend Pro 4 to 5.x… confirmation isn't drawn.
findings.resolution: Northside keeps the Past due pill, and its Duration line is plain 'Grace until Oct 14'. Its holder line adds '· In an account'. List order is best first (the licensing-core audit: rank, top = best), so tiers are now listed Pro, Pro trial, Pro 4, Standard here and the tier records say 1st, 2nd and 3rd of 4. Phone lines read '7 of 10 devices'. The foot shows '1–50 of 240' with previous and next buttons. The Extend dialog is a new screen, entitlements.extend-major: it names the 64 licenses and 5.0.0-beta.1, and its button is 'Give 64 licenses 5.x'.
